objs.name: document
objs.description: General document artifact that can be created, edited, released and distributed within P&R management.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: The abbreviation of the document type used in naming (e.g., RL for a directive).

attributes.name: type_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References attribute maintained via the document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications related to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas or entities where the document is valid.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) included in the document (from TAG technology).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment object linked to a main document.

attributes.name: main_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the main document the attachment belongs to.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Additional information attached to a document (not subject to the main release cycle).

attributes.name: release_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this information is released with the main document or independently.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Attachment item (equipment) that is attached to a document and may trigger versioning.

attributes.name: main_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the main document the equipment is attached to.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data linked to documents (e.g., IT applications).

attributes.name: master_data_type
attributes.description: Type or category of master data linked to documents.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: An information object that can be attached to documents.
